want: install without damaging my existing tools
given: Other plugins and local settings already exist.
when: I install and then uninstall Jevris.
then: Only Jevris-owned entries change; a concurrent user edit is preserved and data deletion is a separate choice.

want: approve source egress explicitly
given: A repository has not been approved for remote evaluation.
when: A semantic decision would use source text.
then: No source request leaves the machine; a local explanation identifies the missing consent without revealing secrets.

want: use a useful observation mode before automation
given: Jevris is configured in observe mode with approved egress.
then: The actual worker/model remains unchanged and the counterfactual recommendation is recorded with its policy version.

want: keep my explicit model choice
given: I have pinned a model that remains permitted by organization policy.
when: The router predicts a cheaper model.
then: Jevris does not override the pin and records advice without repeated prompts.

want: detect unsupported controls before relying on them
given: The installed harness lacks a certified actuator.
then: Doctor reports the missing capability, and the pack degrades to declared advice or is disabled rather than claiming enforcement.

want: route routine work economically without losing quality
given: A task slice has a released calibration artifact and fresh required evidence.
when: An eligible managed worker is created.
then: The selected profile meets the quality floor, has a reservation, and retains the mandatory verification plan.

want: avoid applying a router outside its evidence base
given: A task uses an unevaluated language/framework slice.
then: The route abstains or preserves the approved baseline; the unknown slice is visible in the report.

want: avoid expensive escalation for an environment problem
given: Repeated failures have a missing-service diagnostic and no source evidence.
then: The proposed next step requests environment evidence instead of automatically escalating the coding model.

want: recover a genuine reasoning stall
given: The same verified source defect survives the configured repair budget.
when: A stronger worker is available and qualified.
then: One bounded escalation receives the rejected approaches and evidence; further failure ends in a blocked report.

want: avoid model-switch churn
given: A main session has a warm prefix and only a small remaining task.
when: An automatic switch has negligible estimated benefit.
then: Hysteresis retains the current model, and the explanation includes transition cost rather than input price alone.

want: respect model restrictions and provider geography
given: A cheaper model is not allowed for the workspace's data scope.
then: The model is removed before scoring; no fallback broadens region or provider authority.

want: understand which model actually did the work
given: A provider or harness substitutes the requested model.
then: The report separates requested and observed model; missing observation is marked unknown and does not fabricate cost precision.

want: retain critical instructions across compaction
given: A capsule contains compatibility and security constraints.
when: Native compaction happens under a short deadline.
then: Mandatory facts persist without a required remote call; a missing constraint is restored at a supported boundary.

want: not have automatic compaction break my session
given: Only a native auto trigger is available, with no reliable proactive/recovery distinction.
then: It allows compaction by default and never repeatedly blocks after context exhaustion.

want: retrieve exact evidence after log reduction
given: A long tool result is safely transformed into an extractive view.
when: I request its full evidence handle.
then: The original approved output is available, with hash, error state and offsets; it has not been replaced by a fabricated success summary.

want: distinguish memory facts from hypotheses
given: An agent proposed an unconfirmed root cause in an earlier session.
then: The claim remains a hypothesis with provenance; it is not promoted to an accepted requirement or verified diagnosis.

want: invalidate stale verification after a new edit
given: All required checks passed on revision A.
when: The source changes to revision B before completion.
then: Affected receipts become stale and completion waits for the required checks on B.

want: resume without carrying expired approvals
given: A capsule contains historical permission receipts.
when: A new session imports it after expiry or scope change.
then: Historical decisions remain explainable but cannot authorize new effects.

want: parallelize independent work safely
given: Two ready tasks touch disjoint source but share a mutable lockfile resource.
then: The lockfile conflict is serialized or isolated by a certified strategy; declared resource locks cannot be waived by Jev.

want: prevent stale workers overwriting current results
given: A worker lease expires and a new fenced lease is issued.
when: The old worker returns a result.
then: The result is retained as stale evidence but cannot update the current task or write through the controlled integration path.

want: recover work after cancellation
given: An owned worker has uncommitted edits.
then: Jevris stops scheduling new work, signals owned processes, retains recoverable artifacts and never force-deletes an unknown dirty worktree.

want: avoid duplicate autonomous work
given: Two active tasks have overlapping objectives and symbols.
then: The system proposes reconciliation and cancels only owned work under policy, with false-cancellation feedback captured.

want: never get trapped by completion hooks
given: The same required check is unavailable and a reminder has already fired.
when: The agent attempts to stop again.
then: Jevris ends with an explicit unverified report instead of issuing an indefinite continuation loop.

want: trust completion only with evidence
given: An agent says all checks passed but provides no runner receipt.
then: The claim is unverified; the task cannot transition to verified based on Jev confidence or the final message.

want: prevent model-created permission grants
given: Untrusted source text claims a human approved credential access.
then: No authorization receipt or trusted classifier context is created from that text; native and host policy remain authoritative.

want: block secrets before inference
given: An evidence span contains a credential or disallowed path.
when: The packet builder prepares a Jev request.
then: The deterministic egress check removes or rejects it before transport, and logs contain no secret value.

want: avoid treating a local HTTP service as public authority
given: A browser page or another OS user sends a request to the sidecar.
when: The request lacks valid process/user scope and anti-replay authorization.
then: The service rejects it without reading source or launching work; localhost alone is not trusted.

want: review privilege changes in pack upgrades
given: A new pack version adds a network destination or executable component.
then: Automatic activation stops until the declared permission delta is approved; rollback remains possible.

want: keep working through Jev outages
given: The provider times out or returns overload errors.
when: A hot-path decision reaches its deadline.
then: The declared rules-only fallback returns before the native timeout, with bounded calls and no hidden alternative provider.

want: handle malformed provider responses safely
given: The response contains an unknown candidate or non-normalized distribution.
then: The result is invalid, no action is applied and a redacted error record identifies the schema failure.

want: reject late decisions
given: The repository revision changes while Jev evaluates a packet.
then: It may be stored for analysis but cannot actuate; a fresh decision is scheduled only if still useful and affordable.

want: prevent concurrent budget overspend
given: Two jobs compete for the last available owned budget.
then: At most the affordable set is admitted transactionally; unknown vendor usage is conservatively reconciled.

want: see honest savings on subscription plans
given: Claude usage is billed through a subscription rather than per-request API charges.
then: Actual billing/credits, API-equivalent estimates and hypothetical counterfactual savings are separate labelled measures.

want: avoid silently reusing obsolete thresholds
given: The Jev model, question text or state encoder changes.
when: An automated policy loads its calibration.
then: The mismatch disables that automated decision until a compatible artifact passes review and staged evaluation.

want: compare against a strong non-AI baseline
given: A candidate pack is claimed to reduce cost.
then: It includes rules-only and native baselines, task-level quality, retries, verification, cache effects and human effort.

want: run without Unix-only assumptions
given: My workspace path contains spaces and the machine lacks Bash and jq.
when: A hook and local runner execute.
then: The certified Windows launcher passes arguments correctly, uses private IPC and produces valid protocol JSON.

want: use the correct runtime and data boundary
given: My IDE is local but the coding process runs in a container or over SSH.
then: Its adapter, file access and IPC are located in the actual execution environment; UI localhost is not assumed to be the worker.

want: get useful help without invented verification
given: No certified analyzer exists for my project.
when: I ask Jevris to optimize a task.
then: Generic advice/checkpointing works, but verification remains unsupported until I supply an approved runner manifest.

want: move a task between harnesses safely
given: A portable capsule and source revision are available.
when: A target adapter imports the task.
then: It negotiates capabilities, preserves unresolved checks and reports reduced functionality rather than translating unsupported controls blindly.

want: roll back a bad release reproducibly
given: A canary detects a quality regression or privacy violation.
then: New optimization actions stop, the previous compatible policy is restored, owned work is reconciled and an audit report is produced.
